title: Tutorial: Analyzing Ice Cream Shops in Utah Using Yelp Data
text:
1. Introduction
This tutorial demonstrates how to use the Ice Cream Shop Analysis Python package to collect, clean, analyze, and visualize Yelp business data.
The project focuses on ice cream shops in Utah County and Salt Lake County and investigates how business characteristics such as:

Review volume

Delivery availability

Price level

City location

relate to customer ratings on Yelp.

title: Utah Ice Cream Shop Analysis Package
text:
This project analyzes Yelp Ice Cream businesses in Utah County and Salt Lake County to explore how review volume, city, price and delivery relate to customer ratings.
The package provides tools for: - Cleaning Yelp API data - Analyzing features - Analyzing relationships between business characteristics and ratings - Visualizing results
